# satus

> A CLI that reads your Postgres schema and writes realistic, relationally-coherent seed data that respects foreign keys and constraints. Postgres only. CLI only.

satus is distributed as the npm package `@passkeybridge/satus` (binary: `satus`, Node >= 20). It introspects your live Postgres schema from pg_catalog (tables, columns, PKs, FKs with deferrability, single-column uniques, enums, partitioned tables), builds a dependency DAG from foreign keys, topologically sorts the insert order, breaks FK cycles by deferring a nullable back-edge and back-patching it after all tables are seeded, and generates rows with an LLM you bring your own key for (OpenAI or Anthropic; xAI from the CLI release after 0.3.11). All inserts for a run happen in one transaction: a failure rolls everything back. Three built-in prompt profiles (`saas`, `ecommerce`, `b2b`) shape tone and value distributions so data looks like a real business instead of `John Doe`.

## Canonical commands

```bash
# Install (or run via npx @passkeybridge/satus)
npm install -g @passkeybridge/satus

# One-time interactive setup in a project (writes ./satus.config.json)
satus init

# Plan + validate offline: cost estimate, simulated rows, relational
# validation. No LLM calls, no writes. Exits 2 on validation errors
# (usable as a CI gate). Add --json for a machine-readable report.
satus generate --profile ecommerce --dry-run

# Generate and insert for real
satus generate --profile ecommerce --rows 50

# Activate a paid license (Free tier needs no activation)
satus activate satus_live_...

# Show the cached license state
satus whoami
```

## Flags on `satus generate`

`--profile saas|ecommerce|b2b` · `--rows <n>` (default 50) · `--max-cost <usd>` (default 1.00, aborts + rolls back before overshooting) · `--batch-size <n>` (default 25 rows per LLM call) · `--dsn <url>` · `--schema <name>` (default public) · `--provider openai|anthropic|xai` (auto-detected from which API key env var is set; errors if both OpenAI and Anthropic keys are set and no explicit choice; XAI_API_KEY is used only when neither is set; xai from the CLI release after 0.3.11) · `--model <id>` (defaults: gpt-4o-mini / claude-haiku-4-5 / grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning) · `--truncate` (TRUNCATE ... RESTART IDENTITY on target tables before inserting, same transaction; deliberately NO CASCADE: if a table outside the run set has an FK into one inside it, the run errors instead of emptying it) · `--force` (bypass the 10,000-row safety guard) · `--dry-run` · `--verbose` · `--json`

## Environment

```bash
export DATABASE_URL=postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db   # or SATUS_DATABASE_URL, or --dsn
export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...        # or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-... (pick one)
```

`OPENAI_BASE_URL` / `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` / `XAI_BASE_URL` override the API endpoints (compatible providers, proxies).

## Tiers, exit codes, limits

- Free tier: 25 rows/table, 5 tables, no activation needed. Pro/Team (via https://satus.sh/pricing) remove the caps.
- Exit codes: `0` success, `1` error (connection, config, LLM, budget), `2` dry-run validation findings.
- Known v0.x limits, stated honestly: multi-column unique constraints are not enforced during generation; cross-column arithmetic (e.g. order totals summing from line items) is not reconciled; LLM output is not deterministic and there is no --seed flag — snapshot seeded state with pg_dump for reproducible fixtures.

## GitHub Action

Use `PasskeyBridge-LLC/satus/packages/action@main` — a composite action that installs the CLI and runs `satus generate` (optionally `--dry-run`) against a workflow-provided DATABASE_URL. Reference: https://satus.sh/docs/github-action.
